items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Sure, I know Beansy well. I know his wife, Nancy.

ctx.x: On the barbaco's. Yeah. I was. You remember a fellow named, uh, did you know a fellow named Beansy? Foray? Beansy? Uh, Gammler? Yeah.
Sure, I know Beansy well. I know his wife, Nancy. She's running around with Nancy.
We saw him over down there.
